episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: In order to wish for immortality and avenge his father, Garlic Jr. collects the dragon balls, kidnapping Goku's son Gohan in the process. Goku, Kami, Piccolo, and Krillin unite to rescue Gohan and save the world from being sucked into a dead zone.

info.title: La Ricompensa Del Gatto
info.synopsis: La giovane Haru, dopo aver salvato un gatto dall'essere investito, riceve la visita di alcuni strani gatti parlanti che la invitano nel Paese dei Gatti, dove riceverà una ricompensa per il suo atto di coraggio e generosità. Ma la ricompensa si scoprirà essere quella di dover sposare il Principe dei Gatti, e di trasformarsi anche lei in un gatto!

info.title: I'm the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
info.synopsis: Nella sua vita precedente Liam ha vissuto un'esistenza da persona responsabile che seguiva la morale... fino a quando non morì indebitato e tradito dalla moglie. Rinato nella famiglia regnante di un vasto impero intergalattico, ha capito che la vita è divisa fra gli oppressi e coloro che li calpestano, decidendo che questa volta vivrà una vita completamente egoistica. Ma per qualche motivo sembra che le cose si rifiutino di funzionare come desidera; nonostante faccia il suo meglio per diventare un tiranno, infatti, qualsiasi decisione da lui presa porta pace e prosperità al suo dominio, assieme a un'inaspettata popolarità.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.synopsis: He spent his life working for a black company, only to learn that his beloved daughter was born from the man his wife spent years cheating on him with - his own boss. Yearning for revenge on his death bed, he's reincarnated in a space fantasy as the Evil Lord Liam.

episodes.title: Rebirth
episodes.synopsis: At the ripe age of 5, Liam is gifted a custom-order AI robot by his parents, and then granted full control of their fiefdom, the stellar system of Alcaeus, so they can abandon him for the capital and leave him shouldered with the family's debts.

episodes.title: La Scuola del Lampo
episodes.synopsis: Uscito dalla capsula, Liam cerca un maestro per diventare più forte e inizia a governare la sua contea.

episodes.title: First Battle
episodes.synopsis: Nias customizes the Avid. Liam masters Flash, then defends his mine from pirates.

episodes.title: Honey Trap
episodes.synopsis: Liam uses his loot from the pirates to replace his fleet and Nias tries to seduce him into buying her ships.

episodes.title: Treasure Island
episodes.synopsis: Logs on the pirate ships reveals their home base and Liam argues with the warp gate so he can go raid them.

episodes.title: Princess Knight
episodes.synopsis: Goaz tortures Christiania and her soldiers, grotesquely modifying their bodies. Liam rescues them.

episodes.title: Harem Project
episodes.synopsis: Liam tries to build an NTR harem, but struggles because over 10,000 women are ready to eagerly consent to it.

episodes.title: Mass-Produced Maids
episodes.synopsis: Liam laments not being more of an evil lord but his people & robots love him. The Guide leads pirates to him.

episodes.title: Decisive Battle
episodes.synopsis: The Goaz pirates declare war on the Banfield domain, and Liam faces them in battle.

episodes.title: Evil Lord
episodes.synopsis: Liam routs the pirates and faces Goaz in a final showdown.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.synopsis: After hearing about Liam's success, his good-for-nothing family comes begging for more money.

info.title: Megazone 23 Part III (ITA)
info.synopsis: Eiji Takanaka è famoso per un solo motivo: è il più bravo ai videogames a memoria d`uomo. I suoi amici sono quindi sorpresi quando viene assunto dalla potentissima corporazione E-X. Ma è solo allora che iniziano i veri problemi: ben presto anche Eiji, come Shogo molto tempo prima di lui, si trova a lottare per la propria vita; e di nuovo tutti gli indizi puntano al misterioso programma EVE. Ma è sempre lo stesso programma, o anche qui qualcosa è cambiato? E se il tempo dell’esilio si è concluso, perchè l`umanità vive ancora rinchiusa nel ventre dell`immensa Megazone

episodes.title: The Awakening Of Eve
episodes.synopsis: Years after the events of Megazone 23 II, the only city on Earth is the supposedly idyllic Eden. There lives Eiji Takanaka, a B Level hacker who has just been accepted into EX, the organization that controls Eden. However, before his first day on the job, he becomes embroiled in a network war, a legendary figure named EVE, and a plot to re-inhabit the Earth.

episodes.title: Day of Liberation
episodes.synopsis: Eve si risveglia ed aiuta Eiji a scoprire un progetto chiamato "Project Heaven", attraverso il quale si vuole rispedire gli esseri umani nello spazio per salvare nuovamente la Terra. Sarà nuovamente Eve a salvare l'umanità, sacrificando se stessa definitivamente e distruggendo nel contempo tutte le macchine che controllano la vita umana.

info.title: Hell Teacher Nube: 0 a.m. Nube Dead
info.synopsis: Un nuovo studente arriva nella classe di Nube. Si chiama Jun ed è un ragazzo solitario che ama moltissimo i clown. Il suo unico amico è Pierre, un clown che vive nello specchio. Una notte, Pierre regala a Jun una maschera dai poteri misteriosi. Da quel momento, Jun inizia a comportarsi in modo strano e molti incidenti cominciano ad accadere nella scuola.

episodes.title: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
episodes.synopsis: As Momo fends off an attack in the outdoor hot spring, Okarun and Jiji panic over how to handle the mysterious room. The doorbell rings.

episodes.title: The Evil Eye
episodes.synopsis: In a bid to free Okarun and Momo from the Mongolian Death Worm’s psychic power, Jiji attempts to carry them to safety but runs into a powerful entity.

episodes.title: You Won`t Get Away with This!
episodes.synopsis: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

episodes.title: That`s, Like, Way Deadly
episodes.synopsis: Momo tries to stop the magma, but the Kito family gets in her way. The tsuchinoko shrine priest joins the fray... but so does the possessed Jiji.

episodes.title: We Can All Stay There Together!
episodes.synopsis: With everyone safely back at Seiko's house, Momo and the others discover that water has a surprising effect on how Evil Eye possesses Jiji's body.

episodes.title: We Became a Family
episodes.synopsis: The hayashi musicians arrive and begin an energetic exorcism performance. But just when the ritual is about to succeed, Jiji makes a surprising plea.

episodes.title: Feeling Kinda Gloomy
episodes.synopsis: Okarun has an awkward time at the maid café where Momo works. Seiko tries teaching Jiji how to suppress Evil Eye's possession of his body.

episodes.title: You Can Do It, Okarun!
episodes.synopsis: Aira and Okarun battle the classical composer spirits. As Okarun struggles to avoid their attacks, Turbo Granny orders him to feel the rhythm.

episodes.title: I Want to Rebuild the House
episodes.synopsis: Putting his training to the test, Okarun goes all-out and holds his own against Evil Eye, but the effort causes him to revert to his human form.

episodes.title: The Secret Art of Being Attractive
episodes.synopsis: Momo goes to Okarun's classroom to tell him about the golden ball spotted in the housing complex and finds him speaking with a curious classmate.

episodes.title: Hey, It`s a Kaiju
episodes.synopsis: The sky darkens as Momo, Okarun and Kinta try to evade the giant space monster. They soon run into Aira and Jiji, who give them some much-needed help.

episodes.title: Clash! Space Kaiju vs. Giant Robot!
episodes.synopsis: As Momo and the others try to pilot the giant Buddha robot and battle the kaiju, Okarun and Jiji are ejected from the robot and land in a rice paddy.

episodes.title: Puniru Returns
episodes.synopsis: After Puniru goes missing in the middle of training to become cuter, Kotaro receives an unexpected package.

episodes.title: Going on a Journey with My Childhood Friend Slime in Another World. And Valentine`s, Too!
episodes.synopsis: Kotaro is hit by a truck and finds himself in a world of swords and sorcery. Puniru learns about Valentine's.

episodes.title: Rune Rune Dance
episodes.synopsis: When Runru breaks down one day, Puniru and Kotaro must find a way to have her repaired, but at what cost?

episodes.title: A Being More Perfect Than a Toy
episodes.synopsis: After a science lab mishap, Dr. Mado unveils his latest creation: a super-intelligent robot made of slime!

episodes.title: Puniru Powers Up?! See It for Yourself!
episodes.synopsis: Kotaro has big plans for the summer, but could he be his own worst enemy? Meanwhile, Puniru seeks to power up.

episodes.title: A Human Happy Ending
episodes.synopsis: Gelee becomes the center of attention among the school's boys, including Kotaro, much to Puniru's chagrin.

episodes.title: A Midsummer`s Runrune Resort
episodes.synopsis: Alice invites Kotaro to stay at Runrune Resort, but all Kotaro can think about is Gelee and her advances.

episodes.title: Trick or Kawaii!
episodes.synopsis: Gelee joins Kotaro's class as a student, to her chagrin. Meanwhile, Puniru plans a big surprise for Halloween.

episodes.title: Art Is All About "Kawaii"!
episodes.synopsis: Hodai hatches a scheme to discredit Kotaro in Alice's eyes by having him face Nanpa in an artistic face-off.

episodes.title: Friendly Enough to Always Argue
episodes.synopsis: Kotaro gets into a big fight with Puniru, who runs away to Mami's apartment and meets the Kirara family.

episodes.title: The Human Condition
episodes.synopsis: Kotaro holds a study group with friends, but his careless remark to Gelee ends up having dire consequences.

episodes.title: That`s What the World Calls Love
episodes.synopsis: Puniru turns into a perfect human girl, but Kotaro doesn't seem as happy to hear the news as everyone else.

info.title: Lupin the Third: La donna chiamata Fujiko Mine
info.synopsis: La serie è incentrata soprattutto sul personaggio di Fujiko Mine, parlando del suo passato. La narrazione parte col suo primo incontro/scontro con Lupin III, entrambi interessati alla formula segreta di una potente droga. Fujiko conoscerà poi anche Daisuke Jigen e Goemon Ishikawa, suoi futuri soci insieme a Lupin, e l’ispettore Koichi Zenigata.

episodes.title: Master Thief vs. Lady Looter
episodes.synopsis: Tells the story of how Fujiko Mine first met Arsène Lupin III. Fujiko is on a mission to infiltrate a drug operation, which is not helped by the arrival of master thief Lupin.

episodes.title: .357 Magnum
episodes.synopsis: After losing to a widow in a high stakes casino game, Fujiko has to take on her reuqest. She wants the gun of the man who killed her husband, so Fujiko finds herself going after the infamous gunman Daisuke Jigen.

episodes.title: The Lady and the Samurai
episodes.synopsis: The king of Austrian's grandchildren board a train carrying highly valued artworks, to get to her target Fujiko impersonates herself as Maria, their tutor. While on board, she runs into a mysterious samurai from the East - Goemon Ishikawa.

episodes.title: Vissi D`Arte, Vissi D`Amore
episodes.synopsis: Lupin the Third has declared that he will steal the mask of a famous opera singer. Inspector Zenigata takes note of this challenge, and decides to personally attend the singer's next performance.

episodes.title: Blood-Soaked Triangle
episodes.synopsis: As Lupin attempts to woo Fujiko, she tells him about a jewel peacock at the bottom of a pyramid in Egypt. Meanwhile, Jigen, who is short on cash after being scammed, goes on a search for the peacock as well. Jigen soon finds himself fighting against not only Lupin, but the various traps set up by looters. After both Lupin and Jigen fall into a trap together, Fujiko appears revealing the peacock will appear if one of them dies in the trap. However, they both manage to escape by sacrificing some scorpions. The peacock reveals itself, but Fujiko is forced to give it up in order to escape from the pyramid.

episodes.title: Prison of Love
episodes.synopsis: Fujiko is after the pendant belonging to a student in an all girls school. To get closer to her target, she impersonates herself as one of the teachers in the school.

episodes.title: Music and Revolution
episodes.synopsis: Fujiko and Goemon become involved in a case that could very well lead to World War III.

episodes.title: Dying Day
episodes.synopsis: Fortune-teller Shitoto can guess the "Death Date" of any person. The victims are all former marks of Lupin III. Jigen is hired to destroy the lithograph Shitoto uses to read these fortunes. Lupin teams up with Jigen, however, Lieutenant Oscar is waiting for him. What does this fortune teller have in store for the fate of Fujiko?

episodes.title: Love Wreathed in Steam
episodes.synopsis: Lupin and Jigen find themselves looking after a girl who was used as a living piece of art, whilst evading Fujiko, who desperately wants to kill her for personal reasons.

episodes.title: Ghost Town
episodes.synopsis: Lupin investigates a group of owl people who desire Fujiko and begins to learn more about Fujiko's past whilst fighting off illusions brought on by a strange drug.

episodes.title: The Feast of Fools
episodes.synopsis: As Goemon tries to look after Fujiko, Oscar disguises himself as Fujiko and frames her for various perfect crimes in an attempt to gain Zenigata's favour.

episodes.title: The Woman Called Fujiko Mine (Part 1)
episodes.synopsis: Fujiko, Zenigata, Lupin, and Jigen go to a strange theme park to finally confront Fujiko's past, and the deranged Count Luis Yew Armied.

episodes.title: The Woman Called Fujiko Mine (Part 2)
episodes.synopsis: Fujiko enters a chamber where Count Luis Yu Almeida is sitting and waiting for her, however Lupin interferes from a communications room and being gunned by Jigen, who inhaled the Fraulein Eule Cult drug, which makes Lupin flee. Fujiko falls into another chamber where message appears in blocks and Lupin assists Fujiko to reach again the top. In a special room, Lupin explains the real events that occurred in the tragedy of Eulenspiegel and the process of brutally inducing mind control to little girls. Also in the room lies Dr. Kaiser's daughter Aisha who has been long time experimented for the sake of Count Almeida and now frail and weakened. Fujiko reveals that she entered the manor as a maid and intends to steal the Fraulein Eule cult drug, however she's been cornered by Almeida's men and experimented her as well. Her drive to steal and indulge in sex made Aisha somewhat happy. As the conversation draws close, Lupin gets Aisha and unmasks "Minerva's" Owl who happens to be Aisha's mother who survived the Eulenspiegel tragedy. Lupin and Fujiko brings Aisha to a coastline, but Aisha succumbs due to her weakened state. Fujiko challenges Lupin to steal her but Lupin ends up in failure catching her because of immediate breakdown of Lupin's car.

episodes.title: Dog & Chainsaw
episodes.synopsis: Denji is a teenager who lives his life as a Devil Hunter. Aiming to pay off the debt he inherited from his father, he starts hunting devils for the yakuza with his buddy Pochita, a "Chainsaw Devil", while living a tragically poor life. Just when things seem like they couldn't get any worse, Denji gets betrayed and killed by the yakuza. As Denji starts passing out, he hears someone calling from inside his head...

episodes.title: Arrival in Tokyo
episodes.synopsis: After being taken into custody by Makima, one of the Public Safety Devil Hunters, Denji finds himself head over heels in love with her thanks to her suggestive insinuations. Wishing to team up with Makima, Denji arrives at the Devil Hunters Headquarters in Tokyo, and gets introduced to Aki Hayakawa, a senior hunter that he was supposed to partner with. But then Hayakawa beats Denji up, and demands that he “quit this job”...

info.title: Harmony of Mille-Feuille
info.synopsis: Uta Komaki è una ragazza del primo anno delle superiori con una grande passione per il canto, ma è estremamente timida e insicura. Desidera unirsi al club di musica leggera della scuola, ma si sente sopraffatta dalla presenza dei membri più esperti e carismatici. In un momento di sconforto, riceve un invito a unirsi al club di canto a cappella, guidato dalla presidente Airi Kojo. Questo gruppo è composto da individui unici, alcuni dei quali potrebbero sembrare eccentrici. Anche se non sono popolari o appariscenti, condividono una passione profonda per la musica e una connessione speciale che li unisce attraverso le loro voci.

episodes.title: Pop Music Debut?!
episodes.synopsis: April. Uta, a freshman, is starting high school and aims to join the light music club. However, when she sees the glamorous boys and girls of the light music club chatting away, her extremely negative personality makes her hesitant to take the first step.

episodes.title: Ururun TV
episodes.synopsis: Uta struggles with her first a cappella practice. Meanwhile, a new member candidate found by club president Airi becomes a hot topic. All the club members go out to recruit her to take on the role of "voice percussion," a unique part of a cappella.

episodes.title: A Sky with No Rain Left

episodes.title: Farewell Party!

episodes.title: Zero Hour
episodes.synopsis: Captain Celebrity's farewell party begins, but the Scarred Man has some unpleasant surprises in store...

episodes.title: Balloon Soul

episodes.title: This Is a Hero!!

episodes.title: Graduation and Career Path

info.title: Waccha PriMagi!
info.synopsis: Matsuri Hibino, studentessa del primo anno delle scuole medie, adora i festival e sogna di poter un giorno recitare in "PriMagi", una forma magica di intrattenimento teatrale nata dal canto, dalla danza e dalla moda. Quel giorno arriva quando l'inquietante ma divertente maga Myamu arriva dal regno magico e cerca proprio Matsuri per PriMagi. Insieme, le due competono con le altre rivali per scalare la vetta del successo.

episodes.title: Let`s Compete in the PriMagi!
episodes.synopsis: Myamu wants to win the PriMagi, but first she’ll need a lookbook. And before she can get a lookbook, she’ll need a partner! Wow, becoming a PriMagi star sure is a lot of work…

episodes.title: Here We Go! The Festival Stage
episodes.synopsis: Recon is an important part of honing one’s craft, so Myamu and Matsuri check out Miruki, another PriMagi star performing at a local festival. But there’s just one problem…

episodes.title: A Visit from Hina, the Queen of Style!
episodes.synopsis: So many new faces, but are Matsuri’s fellow PriMagi hopefuls new friends or budding rivals? Or maybe they’re both…

episodes.title: The Duo Disbands?! It`s Way Too Soon for That!
episodes.synopsis: Wait, Myamu wants to disband!? She claims she needs a better partner, but is that the real reason she’s run away from Matsuri?

episodes.title: Hey, Look! It`s the Super-Duper Cute Miruki! (Heart)
episodes.synopsis: All’s fair in love and war… and fashion photography! Miruki won’t pull any punches to sabotage Matsuri’s big break, but Matsuri has luck on her side.

episodes.title: The Dark PriMagi Superstar?! Lemon Takes the Stage!
episodes.synopsis: Lemon Kokoa might be shy, but she has big PriMagi dreams! She’ll have to find the courage to perform somehow. Maybe Hina and Matsuri can offer some inspiration.

episodes.title: The Downright Merry Meowgnificent Magical Realm!
episodes.synopsis: An unexpected trip to the magical realm makes Myamu and Gramps butt heads, but Lemon’s ability to sniff out “key items” may just bring them together again…

episodes.title: A Crash Course with Hina-senpai! OMG, OMG, I`m Doomed!
episodes.synopsis: Matsuri joins Hina for a training session to improve her PriMagi skills, but Hina’s intense routine and unmatched passion leaves her feeling the burn!

episodes.title: A Heart Awakens! `Tis the Advent of Lemon!!
episodes.synopsis: Lemon knows just what to do to cheer up Matsuri, but when Lemon finally gets her turn on the PriMagi stage, Matsuri will need to do the cheering instead!

episodes.title: Nothing Beats the PriMagi! A Mega-Enthusiastic Meet-up!
episodes.synopsis: While out celebrating Lemon’s debut, Matsuri and her friends take a look through their lookbooks to see how far they’ve come — all in preparation for the challenges ahead!

episodes.title: Fly, Hina! Conquer Your Loneliness!
episodes.synopsis: PriMagi superstar Jennifer makes a shocking announcement that leaves Hina feeling rattled before a huge performance. The show must go on, but can Hina shine in her condition?

episodes.title: Matsuri vs Hina: Upon Whom Will the Phoenix Smile?
episodes.synopsis: Hina and Matsuri might be friends, but there can only be one PriMagi superstar! Which of their stars is about to rise, and whose will come falling back to earth?

episodes.title: The Magic Word Is Waccha
episodes.synopsis: Something is wrong with Myamu. Between her troubles and Matsuri’s doubts, the pair will have to pull off a miracle to get Matsuri to the top — but they’re up to the challenge!

episodes.title: Passionate, Mysterious, Elegant: Amane`s PriMagi
episodes.synopsis: Prince Amane is in trouble, or at least that’s what her PriMagi partner claims. Amane says everything is fine, but Hina suspects Amane’s acting skills are working overtime.

episodes.title: So Much for That! I`m Sick of This Stupid Training Camp!
episodes.synopsis: At a special training camp for top stars, the team of hopefuls must work together to survive the week, but some students don’t want to shoulder their fair share of chores…

episodes.title: Touma`s "Magi," Hughie`s "Magi"
episodes.synopsis: An impromptu trip to the magical world with the mysterious Hughie puts Touma in grave danger, but Matsuri and her friends are on their way to help!

episodes.title: Chimumu Says Thanks for Everything, Chimu...
episodes.synopsis: The stars of the training camp aren’t the only ones who need to get serious about their craft. Their magical partners have work to do, too!

episodes.title: Amane`s Heart, a Secret Garden
episodes.synopsis: When a magical rose reveals Amane’s hidden feelings, animosity flowers amid the stars at the special training camp.

episodes.title: Together! On Another Journey to the Magical Realm!
episodes.synopsis: During a surprise day off, the stars take a break from the cameras and visit the Magical Realm… but the magical paparazzi wants to put them right back in the spotlight!

episodes.title: The Trial of a Lifetime! Miruki`s Cute Court Case!
episodes.synopsis: The results of the audience poll leave the stars in turmoil — and with an unprecedented decision to make. But Miruki has a (slightly suspicious) plan to get the votes.

episodes.title: I Am Jennifer!
episodes.synopsis: It’s Jennifer-mania when the legendary star returns for an unexpected performance! But something about her energy feels off. Looks like even champions struggle sometimes…

episodes.title: Tune In for a Special Broadcast! Ole!
episodes.synopsis: In a pre-exhibition special, the Superstars showcase their past performances to pick the most impressive among them — but not all feel ready to shine their brightest.

episodes.title: The Final Test: A Five-Man Center!
episodes.synopsis: It's time to face the music. The top stars must band together to put on a performance of a lifetime!

episodes.title: Exhibition, Here We Come! Five Times the Magi!
episodes.synopsis: The girls celebrate the success of their five-man center, but the reality of the PriMagi is waiting in the wings. What comes after this feeling of happiness…?

episodes.title: Identity Data File: In the Case of Auru Omega
episodes.synopsis: A new challenger has emerged, but Auru Omega has an unorthodox view of the PriMagi. She intends to win not with magic, but with science! Can her clinical approach get results?

episodes.title: Auru`s Eikichi Research Guide!
episodes.synopsis: Auru’s newest research mission: understanding Matsuri and her PriMagi skills! Will spending time with Matsuri and her family unlock the next step in Auru’s PriMagi evolution?

episodes.title: The Fate That Binds Us
episodes.synopsis: Behind the glittering face of the PriMagi stage, ominous forces move in the shadows. A new future for the PriMagi approaches, but what does this mean for Matsuri and Myamu?

episodes.title: You`re My Precious One! Our Magi!
episodes.synopsis: The Earthly and the Treasured have worked together for centuries, but if Omega has their way, things for the PriMagi are about to change — permanently.

episodes.title: Who`s Gonna Team Up? It`s a Matchmaking Competition
episodes.synopsis: After witnessing a surprise performance from an unlikely pair, the rest of the superstars want to try a duo PriMagi, too! But Miruki has some reservations about teaming up…

episodes.title: Glasses and Contacts
episodes.synopsis: Matsuri wants to perform a duo PriMagi with Auru, but Auru has always done things better alone. In fact, she’s ALWAYS been alone… hasn’t she?

episodes.title: Magi? Technology? It`s Time for a Duo PriMagi!
episodes.synopsis: Auru and Matsuri are performing together? Talk about an odd couple! Can magic and technology learn to work in harmony, or will this team-up end in discord?

episodes.title: A Lonesome Flower: Amane`s Magi
episodes.synopsis: Amane and Hina have a duo to perform, but how can you pour your heart into something when you don’t know what your heart holds? Amane must look inward to discover the truth.

episodes.title: Those Who Shoot For the Stars
episodes.synopsis: Hina is this year’s Samba Sun Goddess, but the arrival of another PriMagi Superstar has cast a shadow over her shining moment...

episodes.title: My Very Own Vivid Star
episodes.synopsis: PriMagi Superstars may be rivals, but they’re also friends. No matter what, they’ll be there for Hina while she finds her footing after her confrontation with Jennifer.

episodes.title: Fly High! Hina and Amane`s Duo!
episodes.synopsis: Hina fans vs. Amane fans — two households, both alike in dignity, in fair PriMagi, where we lay our scene. Can a duo between Amane and Hina strive to mend this ancient grudge?

episodes.title: Farewell, Lemon! Carron Bows Out
episodes.synopsis: When Lemon’s nerves get the best of her, Miruki sees an opportunity to shine solo — and Carron runs out of patience with her PriMagi partner.

episodes.title: Are You Sure About This?! MiruLemo Date!
episodes.synopsis: Lemon and Miruki go on a date, but things don't go according to plan.

episodes.title: `Tis the Moment of Truth! This Here Is Our Duo!
episodes.synopsis: Lemon learns something surprising about Miruki.

episodes.title: A Red-Hot Dreamer: Achihiko Omega
episodes.synopsis: The CEO of the mysterious Omega Corporation reveals the philosophy driving his ambitions during a special look back at the meteoric rise of the latest PriMagi superstars.

episodes.title: You Are My Sunshine
episodes.synopsis: As various players' motivations come to light, PriMagi as an institution faces a reckoning that could change the landscape of that magical stage forevermore.

episodes.title: Is the PriMagi Gone for Good?!
episodes.synopsis: The deed is done and there is no going back. Now, the Elemental Spirits and the mysterious Euphoria Revue holds the key to what happens next.

episodes.title: The Distance Between Me and My Magi
episodes.synopsis: Problems that can't be solved by the Earthly must be solved by the Treasured, and the Treasured intend to use force. But Lemon wants to take a different approach.

episodes.title: I Want to Win! Hear My Magi Roar!
episodes.synopsis: The stars must succeed at the Euphoria Revue, but who will be the next to unlock her Heavens Form? The upcoming PriMagj will be crucial for whoever takes to the stage!

episodes.title: Have a Taste of Miruki`s Milky Dream (Wink)
episodes.synopsis: Miruki wants to unlock her Heavens Form right NOW! But the Element who just came calling has a rather odd request. Is changing who she is really worth all this!?

info.title: Ghost Cat Anzu
info.synopsis: Karin è una ragazza di undici anni che viene abbandonata dal padre a case del nonno, un monaco di una piccola cittadina della campagna giapponese. Il nonno chiede ad Anzu, un gatto fantasma tanto gioviale quanto capriccioso, di prendersi cura della nipote. All'inizio fra i due nascono scintille a causa dei loro forti caratteri, ma poi...

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: The evil Dr. Kochin uses the dragon balls to resurrect his mentor, Dr. Wheelo, in an effort to take over the world. Dr. Wheelo, his body having been destroyed by the avalanche that killed him fifty years before, desires the body of the strongest fighter in the world as his new vessel. Believing Roshi to be the world's strongest warrior, Dr. Kochin abducts Bulma and forces Roshi to surrender himself to save her. When Goku hears of their abduction, he goes to their rescue.
